_about: V6 = short-horizon head-IMU / WISER fusion, cohort 2026c (wiser/scripts/analyze_wiser_v6_fusion.py; plan implementation_plan/2026-10-03-wiser-v6-fusion.md, approved by the user 2026-10-03 '开始', committed e0252c8 before any V6 number; operational details in its Amendment 1, written before any V6 number). One EKF + extended RTS per animal and period on a 16-Hz grid with the WISER fixes inserted; state (p, v, b, psi); input = make_imu lin_acc_earth x/y low-passed at 2 Hz; B2 fix noise model, chi2 gate + 2 Huber IRLS passes; V3's ZUPT; fallback = no input, q 3 in^2/s^3. Periods, animals, exclusions, IMU seconds and certified still segments are the failure audit's; S1/S5 definitions the default-smoother step's; the clean-WISER speed reference step B's; B2 = the smoothing pilot's tuned B2; V3 = the V3 step's candidate (wiser_v3_2026c.json). Candidate, split, thresholds and the decision rule are the plan's and must not be changed after a result. The run writes the tuned values (tuning night 09-07 only) into `tuned` and its verdict into `decision`. A new cohort = a new copy of this file + a re-run.

input._note: zero-phase Butterworth (sosfiltfilt) on each contiguous run of valid 50-Hz samples (failure-audit sample_valid), linear interpolation onto the absolute 16-Hz field-PC grid; 16-Hz samples within edge_s of a run end are not QC-ok; QC-ok also needs the audit's per-second ok (Amendment 1.2)

v6._note: state (px, py, vx, vy, bx, by, psi); input steps q_a, fallback steps q_fallback (= B2's q); Huber k 2.5, chi2 gate 13.8155, 2 IRLS passes, m_rej from tuned.B2 (smoothing config)

tuning._provenance: q_a centre = sigma_a^2/(2 f_c) with sigma_a = 0.25 m/s^2 / 1.1774 (median 2-D magnitude -> per-axis SD) x 39.37 = 8.36 in/s^2 and f_c = 2 Hz -> 17.5 in^2/s^3, x 1/4 and x 4; sigma_b = g sin(0.67 deg) = 4.5 in/s^2 (geometric mean of the 0.3-1.5 deg tilt range), tau_b 1/3/10 s; q_psi = (1, 2, 4 deg)^2 per minute (2 deg/min gyro-bias drift centre). Objective = pooled RMS_pred at L = 1 s over the five animals of the tuning night (Amendment 1.7).

V6_psifix._note: sensitivity: psi frozen at its initial value

V6_ctrl._note: negative control: the acceleration shifted by +1 h (nights)

gapfill._note: centres = clean (step B) IMU-QC-ok locomoting seconds, >= L_max + min_gap apart, same centres for every L; each method rerun once per L with all its hidden fixes invisible (Amendment 1.8)

acceptance._rule: 1. V6 replaces V3 as the default for the implanted animals if the calm-test gain at L = 0.5 s or 1 s is >= 10 % with its 95 % CI above 0, and T1-T4 pass, and the negative control does not invalidate it; B2 stays the universal baseline. 2. Close the inertial-position line (no further INS / acceleration-fusion variants for WISER position) if the gain is not significantly above 0 (CI lower bound <= 0) at both L = 0.5 s and 1 s, or the control invalidates it; V3 stays. 3. Otherwise V3 stays; the report states what V6 offers and at what cost. Control invalid: at L = 0.5 or 1 s where V6's gain > 0, control gain >= 0.5 x V6's gain. Precedence: control -> rule 2 -> rule 1 -> rule 3 (Amendment 1.15).

jitter_check.floor_source: step-B tables/noise_floor.csv, kind all, set all, scale 3, p95 (1.64 in/s)

tuned.handedness_mode: per animal (animals disagree or a fit failed)
tuned.objective: pooled RMS_pred at L = 1 s, night_20260907, five animals

decision.outcome: close the inertial-position line; V3 stays
decision.reason: the calm-test gain is not significantly above 0 (95 % CI lower bound <= 0) at both L = 0.5 s and 1 s
